summary: Discrepancies between Figma source-of-truth and the normalized token names used in the code.

naming.action: Code uses 'neutral' (correct spelling). Update the Figma file to match — the typo is currently exposed in token names.
Code drops the redundant 'B' letter prefix. Same numbering, less visual noise.
Figma has both 'O0' and bare '0' for orange. Code keeps one. Recommend deleting 'base/orange/0' (bare) from Figma.

naming.figma: base/brand/blue/300, 400, 500 (no B prefix, different values from B300/B400/B500)
naming.action: Figma has loose 'base/brand/blue/300' (#0090c6), '400' (#0074ac), '500' (#006399) without the B prefix. These OVERLAP semantically with B300/B400/B500 but have different hexes. Looks like leftovers from an earlier scale. Recommend deleting from Figma.

values.detail: Figma stores shadow alpha as integer percentages (e.g. 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 25)' meaning 25% opacity). The CSS spec requires 0-1 for alpha; '25' is clamped to 1 (fully opaque) by browsers, producing visually-broken shadows.
values.fixedInCode: Yes — divided by 100 in elevation.tokens.json (e.g. 25 → 0.25). The Figma values should be re-saved with proper alpha.

values.detail: Figma reports lineHeightPx = 9.73 for Inter 36px Semibold. That's a single-digit pixel line-height on a 36px font — almost certainly a corrupted value.
values.fixedInCode: Yes — set to 2.75rem (44px) in typography.tokens.json. Designer should investigate the source style.

values.detail: Figma defines 30 base radius values in 100-unit increments. No design system needs this many. Real components likely use 4-6.
values.fixedInCode: Yes — code keeps a 7-step semantic scale: none, sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl, full. Recommend pruning unused base radius values from Figma.

values.detail: Inter has 13 sizes (12-128). Noto Kufi Arabic has only 8 sizes (12-32). Display headings 36, 48, 64, 96, 128 have no Arabic counterpart.
values.fixedInCode: No — code mirrors the gap. Decide whether to add Arabic display sizes in Figma, or restrict display headings to Latin contexts.

components.detail: Web Primary button has 5 states (Default/Hover/Pressed/Focus/Disabled). Web Secondary/Tertiary have 4. Mobile buttons all have 4. State coverage should be uniform within each platform.
Three Arabic Web button component sets are named 'Buton' instead of 'Button'. Only affects the Figma file.
Six Mobile button component sets have '//' (double slash) in their path.

components.where: Mixed locale suffixes: Web-Ar, Web-Arabic, En-AR, Mob-Ar, Mob-Arabic
components.detail: Pick ONE convention. Recommend: drop locale suffixes entirely; treat Latin/Arabic as a runtime concern via 'dir=rtl' + 'lang=ar', not as separate components. The current code already does this.
Mobile-prefixed components live on the Web components page.
Web-prefixed components live on the Mobile components page.
Figma page has 0 children. No patterns documented yet (form layouts, list patterns, empty/loading/error states).
Figma page has only 1 frame. No real templates yet (auth screens, dashboard, settings).
